name: Zitkala-Ša
shortBio: Yankton Dakota philosopher, writer, and Indigenous rights advocate whose critiques of federal boarding schools and colonial Christianity defended Dakota spiritual and civic autonomy.
centralQuestion: How does forced assimilation disguise cultural erasure as "civilization," and how does Indigenous memory resist moral colonization?

keyWorks.title: American Indian Stories
keyWorks.description: Includes "Why I Am a Pagan," a philosophical defense of Dakota ecological-spiritual immanence against colonial dogma.
